norm: the type primarily serves typed sw c connection
assumption: The type primarily serves typed SW-C connection.
rationale: The declaration in Rte_KeyM_Type.h indicates the provision for application components via the RTE, whereas the C APIs expect generic pointers to uint8.

original.text: Annahme: Der Typ dient primär der typisierten SW-C-Anbindung — trifft das zu?
